batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b UT Yadav

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c SP Narine b JH Kallis

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b WD Parnell

balls.text: Duminy was waiting for some space and he gets a low full toss on off that is hammered back over the bowler's head
this is fired in on off stump.. 119 kph.. The batsman digs it out to point for a single
wide outside off but JP drags it to the cow corner with a sweep.. there is a fielder in place for that
fires in a low full toss on the stumps that Duminy clips to deep square leg for a quick couple
here comes the slog sweep that doesn't really care about which way the ball is spinning, picks up a single to deep backward square leg
this one is a big offspinner and keeps spinning away from Duminy, but he still drags it to cow corner
bowls a wide yorker with which the batsman makes no connection

the bowler wins this round, but the batsman takes the points.. KJ was looking to pull this sharp bouncer, but he misses, gets hit on his hip and the ball slides to the right of the keeper, all the way to the boundary
gets in a yorker outside off but JP thumps it all along the ground to long on
looks to play the ramp shot by moving way across to the off side.. but misses
thank you very much says JP! he smashes this low full toss outside off to the top tier of that ugly stand again..
bowls a short delivery on off but the batsman misses out as he hits it straight to point
tucks this one to square leg for an easy single
this round goes to the batsman! He waits and waits, before opening the face of the bat very late to steer it very fine on the off side
he is beaten by the wrong one here but he gets four for that! KJ was charging down the ground, gets a thick outside edge that sails between point and short third man
flatter and on the pads, the batsman dabs it to square leg for a quick single
that's flat and that's in the KKR dug out! It was full and JP stays low before pulling out a powerful slog sweep
tossed up delivery on off, Jadhav calmly dabs it to long on for a single
moves to the leg side and Vinay chases him with a short of length delivery, the batsman flat-bats it to long on without much timing
it's a low full toss on off stump from round the wicket, JP drives it to long on for a single
fuller delivery outside off, he crisply times it to deep cover but just a single this time
where has this gone! Over the ugly stands behind the bowler.. It was a slower ball.. KJ generated some momentum coming down the pitch and whacks it long .. All the way to the top
length delivery outside off, Kadhav doesn't move his feet but punches it to mid-off
he gets room outside off and he cashes in on it, smashing it through backward point with a powerful cut shot
walks across to the offstump, the batsman works it away to square leg for a single
this is too good! it was quicker and honing in on the middle stump. Shukla moved to the leg side expecting it to turn into him, but this just goes straight on and flattens the middle stump
he waits in the crease and defends the incoming delivery to point
this one is on the leg stump line and Shukla gets some proper contact, sweeps it firmly to deep backward square leg
now looks to sweep it across the line and gets punched on the helmet grill
that's a drop by  Shakib! The batsman defends it to cover.. and Shakib ran in, got there, but is not able to hold on
slower delivery on the pads, Shukla was already making room and drives this to deep midwicket
he almost chops this on.. it was just about heading for the leg stump before Shukla booted it away
slower delivery on the pads, the batsman clips it to deep midwicket for a single
fires in a yorker that the batsman flicks straight to square leg.. Shakib fires a throw, but misses
oh this almost carried to the keeper! it was a slower delivery and Shukla wanted to guide it to third man, ended up guiding it to the keeper.. it just drops short of him
length delivery outside off, JP comes forward and caresses it to deep cover
slower delivery outside off, JP waits before running it down to third man for a single
slower delivery outside off, Shukla stays in the crease and whips it to deep midwicket
he makes good contact this time! That was cracked hard towards point, but the fielder dives to his left to cut it off
no feet movement from Shukla as he tries to steer this length delivery down to third man, misses
back of length delivery with no room, JP drops it towards cover point for a quick single
neatly punches the length delivery to wide mid-off to pick up a couple
whoa! He pulls out a boundary from nowhere and that too to a good shot. It was a good delivery on off but Shukla punches it firmly through extra cover.. no chance for the fielder in the deep
another good ball, this is short of length and on the stumps, the batsman gets an inside edge to square leg for a single
another good ball, it's slightly slower and on the stumps, the batsman pushes it straight to midwicket
short ball attempted, but this is one is pounded on the bowler's half, sails way over the batsman
length delivery on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single
slower delivery on the pads, JP punches it to long-on with ease
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it straight to cover
stays back and pushes the flatter delivery straight to midwicket
it's the end! He was looking so good, but as he looks to whack this leg side delivery to deep backward square leg, what he manages is a top-edge that lobs up for Kallis at short fine leg
stays in the crease and punches it down to long on for a single
he comes down the pitch again, the batsman though only pushes it back to Shakib
shorter and wider outside off, JP waits and cuts it behind point to pick up a couple to the deep
he comes down the pitch and punches the flatter delivery to midwicket
and another one! This doesn't have that much room, but the batsman manages to cut it hard past point for yet another boundary
slower delivery, he spots it early and whacks it from wide outside off to the deep midwicket boundary.. He is playing some 100 million rupee shots here
slower delivery on off, the batsman waits an extra second and dabs it to point for a single
gets hit on the body as he looks to clip this back of length delivery to the leg side
the bowler responds with a quick delivery outside off that beats the outside edge!

this is the same shot that AB played off Steyn the other night! Doesn't go that long, but goes long enough to clear the fine-leg boundary. He is down on his knee, across to the offside and helps it on its way over his shoulder
stays back and taps the quicker delivery to short fine leg for a single
he stays deep in the crease and punches it down to long on for a single
he uses his feet and drives it back to the bowler
he comes forward and drives this to long-on for a single
tossed up outside off, JP paddles it fine on the leg side
pushed through on the pads, the batsman defends it towards the vacant midwicket region for an easy single
he has given it away.. Murali looks to launch the length delivery outside off to the long-on boundary.. But he never really looked in control.. Easy catch for Narine at the boundary
he shuffles across a touch to the offside and picks up the slower ball from the middle stump to flick it behind square .. Tendo slides in to stop that, but his boot was kissing the skirting..
walks across and whips the length delivery to midwicket
that's stylish! DK takes a step down the pitch and chases the wide delivery to chip it over extra cover.. But it lands well within the boundary
pushes this one wide outside off and DK has a poke at that, but he plays inside the line to be beaten
bowls an offcutter on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to cover and calls for a quick single
he goes down on his knee even as the ball is released, picks it from wide outside off and drags it to deep backward square leg boundary
he pushes the slower delivery softly towards midwicket for an easy single
slower delivery, the batsman dabs it to point and calls for a quick single
he moves across and punches the length delivery to deep midwicket for a single
here comes the big shot! Effortlessly down. He makes early move down the pitch and just chips the length delivery over the umpire's head.. all the way to the sight screen
starts off with a length delivery on the pads, the batsman looks to flick it, but gets an inside edge to fine leg
he comes forward and punches the length delivery to long on
that's hard on the bowler as this runs off the glove.. It shot up from a length, but to kiss the glove and run down fine on the off side
rises with the ball and punches it to deep extra cover for a couple
that's solid Test-match like defence from DK. He comes forward, meets the ball under his eye, hold the defensive pose for a few seconds
attempts a slower delivery, but this is way down the leg side
tries to flick the length delivery to fine leg, but it runs to short fine leg off the pads
the batsman comes forward and square drives this to deep point for a single
he comes forward and tucks this to square leg for another easy single
he moves well down the leg side to make room and punches this to cover
tossed up outside off, he pushes it to long on for an easy single

what has he done! This is the most stupid dismissal. He comes forward, defends it to cover and just starts running like a mad man. There was no run there.. The keeper moves forward, picks up the ball and runs him out.. KP never really looked back..
looks to whip it to the leg side but gets hit on the pads
he was in trouble for a moment! He came out of the crease, defended as he was not to the pitch of the ball, but the ball clipped the inside edge and rolled towards the leg stump
stays on the back foot and dabs this to cover for a quick single
didn't read this one! He was again shaping for the big drive but it cut back into him.. he manages to defend it to the leg side
defends this off the front foot
that's a good shot! Looks like he spotted the doosra and went ahead with an inside out drive, using his long reach, to scoop it over cover
the sweep again, the ball is well outside off and slips under to beat the bat
he shuffles across the crease and pushes it softly towards mid-on for a single
fuller and on the pads, the batsman pushes it softly to midwicket for a single
tossed up and slower, keeps coming in with the angle, the batsman defends
stays in the crease and dabs the flatter delivery to midwicket for a single
this is outside off but KP is predetermined to play a sweep, gets hit on the front pad but the impact was outside the line
flatter delivery on the leg stump line, he clips is straight to square leg
he comes down the pitch and pushes outside the line, hit on the pads
almost a yorker outside off, the batsman drives it straight to cover
full and swinging, but it also invites Murali to drive and drive he does, through the gap at extra cover. it was in the air for a bit, but in the gap
he is beaten by this one, but this on-the-up drive was not really on here.. He was looking to play this away from his body

one dot, two dot, and here comes the wicket! He looked to clear this fuller delivery over mid-on, but is hit high on the bat and lobs up for Gambhir at mid-on. After two inswinging deliveries, this one went straight on
similar delivery, swings into the pads and rolls towards point.. Vijay, however, is charging down the pitch and has to scamper back.. a direct hit would have had him
gets a good shape on this one, it starts from leg stump and swings into the batsman, hits the pads
he clips this one off his thigh pad to midwicket for an easy single
this one shoots off the pitch and surprises the batsman with the bounce.. flies past the shoulder of the bat
he walks into this length ball and drives it on the up to cover
only marginally short of length and de Kock smashes it off the front foot towards deep midwicket where Tendo dives, but just parries the ball to the boundary
another length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to wide mid-on to turn the strike over
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman whips it straight to square leg
stays in his stance and whips the floated delivery to deep midwicket with ease
moves to the leg side again and pushes the flatter delivery through cover for an easy couple
oye! That almost sneaked under the bat.. The batsman was making room to carve it through cover, but it didn't bounce much and an underedge saves Murali
tossed up delivery on the stumps, Vijay drives to midwicket where Gambhir misfields.. But QdK is not running for those after the previous match.
makes room and punches this to wide mid-off for another easy single
this has been easily punched through cover! Nothing more than a push, but the short length of the ball gave de Kock all the time
slower delivery on the stumps, easily tucked to midwicket for an easy single
tossed up and Kallis shows his class, driving this on the up through extra cover
short delivery, Kallis takes his eyes off while playing the pull but still manages to control it, picks up a single to deep square leg
outside edge! There was a slip in place, but this would have gone to a second slip. Kallis went for the big drive but is lucky to get four for it
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it straight to point
length delivery on the stumps, Kallis is a bit surprised by the extra bounce as he defends down the pitch

Whoa! DK takes a screamer! I was looking at the boundary but DK has leaped a few feet in the air to pluck that out of nowhere! Gambhir went for the pull on a short delivery and got a thick top edge that looked like it was going over the keeper, but DK catches it with his right hand.. Parnell, KP .. all are impressed with that
fires it full on the stumps, Gambhir looks to whack it across the line but gets an inside edge on to his body
flatter delivery, easily punched to long off for a single
he takes a step down and hammers it over the bowler's head.. clean hit, all the way to the sight screen
slower this time, Gambhir looks to push it to cover, but gets an inside edge back down the pitch
fuller and wider outside off, easily creamed to deep cover for a single
this one is short and wide, that is murdered through extra cover with a powerful front-foot swipe
bowls this one wide outside off, easily pushed to deep cover for a single
fuller delivery outside off, Gambhir guides it to third man again.. JP, from gully, dives valiantly but he was not really close to that
Vijay is losing it in the field! It's a simple pick up at deep cover after Gambhir has played a solid punch, but he allows it to run through his legs
fires in a yorker outside off, Gambhir looks to dig it out to third man but makes no connection
he does a GG, guides the length delivery down to third man for a single
length delivery on the pads, easily punched to deep midwicket where fumble by Murali Vijay now allows a second
short of length delivery outside off, again, he lacks the pace to trouble the batsman.. Pandey pulls him off front foot to deep square leg

shorter delivery on the body, it was a touch slower and Gambhir slaps it towards deep square leg.. Good that there is not much timing in this as it lands well short.. Slight fumble from Jadhav allows a second
fires in a yorker and Gambhir digs it out to gully again
slower delivery outside off, Gambhir cuts it straight to gully
run-out chance! Gambhir had given up as Nadeem got to the ball quickly at midwicket and aimed at the non-striker.. but he misses, gives away an extra run too
this time he looks to hit the length ball to midwicket but gets a thick outside edge that just lands short of third man
almost! This skids past the outside edge as Gambhir looks to guide it to third man
length delivery outside off, Pandey leans into his drive but can't find the gap. hits it straight to cover
he looks to drive it over cover but gets a thick outside edge over the hovering gully fielder
length delivery on the pads, the batsman clips it straight to short fine leg
length delivery outside off, Gambhir loves to dab to third man and he does it again
length delivery on the stumps, Pandey pushes it to long on for a single
bowls a gentle half-volley outside off, it's neatly driven through extra cover.. that is not going to test anyone
slower still, Pandey waits and pushes it to cover for asingle
slower and tossed up outside off, the batsman chops it towards point for a single
tossed up delivery wide outside off, the batsman leans forward and slices it through the gap at backward point.. Lots of timing there and they pick up three
another one chipped, but this time over the midwicket fielder, for a single that brings him his second half-century
he comes out of the crease to make the tossed up delivery a half-volley and chips it inside out for a couple of runs
tossed up and full on off, the batsman drives it down to long off
not quite the delivery Tambe produced  as Parnell bowls length on the pads.. Pandey tucks it to square leg to get off the mark

the finger has been raised after a pause! Uthappa was looking to punch this down the ground, but he was walking into this shot.. so slightly off balance.. he plays outside the line of the delivery and is in front of off stump. Good decision by the umpire. Uthappa misses out on a half-century
back of length delivery on the stumps, Gambhir tucks it to square leg for a single
fuller delivery outside off, Gambhir swipes at it to hit it to deep midwicket
another smart punch! He comes forward and punches it down to long off for a single.. no risks being taken
bowls length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it straight to cover
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it down to long on for a single
another short ball, this is asking to be hit.. Uthappa goes leg side this time, hammering it along the ground to deep midwicket boundary
this is nicely done from Uthappa! it's a short delivery outside off, Uthappa waits on the back foot before punching it over extra cover
he is very very very lucky here! Gambhir charged out of the pitch and looked to hit it over midwicket, but gets a thick edge that stays up for a long time only to descend at the vacant mid-off area
he comes forward and pushes this softly to cover for a single
flatter delivery on the stumps, Gamhbir stays back and pulls it to deep midwicket for a single
length delivery on the stumps, Gambhir dabs it to cover and calls for a quick single
this is beautifully hit! Takes you back to the days when Gambhir was 28.. He plants his front foot out and drives it handsomely, in the air, through the gap at extra cover
length delivery on the pads, Robin looks to clip it to square leg but gets a thick leading edge to deep midwicket
he calmly guides this one down to third man for a single
bowls a short of length delivery outside off but at his pace he is not going to scare anyone.. Gambhir clears his front leg out and hammers it over midwicket
waits in the crease and slices the length delivery down to third man for a single
he comes down the pitch and punches the length delivery to wide mid-off for a single
short ball! Gambhir is always a keen puller.. he gets a top-edge that lands safely short of fine leg
slower delivery outside off, easily punched down to long on for a single
this stays a touch low after pitching short of length.. Gambhir, who was hopping, gets a toe end towards mid-off and calls for a quick single
length delivery on off, Gambhir punches it back to the bowler
shorter this time, Gambhir pulls it down to long-on for a single
flatter and outside off, Gambhir chops it to the right of deep point for a couple
he stays in the crease and works this away to deep midwicket
he comes out of the crease but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball, it hits the pads and they take a leg-bye to midwicket
tossed up delivery on off, comes in to Gambhir, who pushes it to cover
now Gambhir repeats the shot Robin played off the last ball, but he doesn't look to hit this to the Purana Qila, times it over midwicket for a one-bounce four
he comes down the pitch, gets a tossed up delivery on the middle stump line and he launches into that one, hitting it over cow corner for a huge hit
tossed up, but this on the leg stump line, Gambhir tickles it down to fine leg for a single
he comes down the pitch and punches the flatter delivery to deep midwicket for a single
slower this time, it's loopy too.. Gambhir comes forward and nudges it to deep square leg
flatter delivery outside off, the batsman waits on the back foot before punching it to wide long off
tossed up delivery on the leg stump line, Gambhir neatly tucks it to deep backward square leg
dabs the short of length delivery to short third man

slower delivery from Kaul! It beats the batsman - it actually takes the edge and is dropping to DK who fluffs the low chance..DK had to dive forward as this was coming slow at him and looks like he misjudged the dipping trajectory. Goes down as a drop
back of length delivery on the stumps, Gambhir nudges it in the gap between short fine leg and backward square leg for a couple
beautiful delivery! It pitches on leg stump and curves in to the batsman to hit the thigh pad.. but it is deflected past a diving DK to the third man boundary
length delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it to point for a quick single
starts off with a good back of length delivery that is clipped straight to square leg where Shukla allows it to go through his legs..
the extra delivery brings bonus six runs! Full, on the pads, meets Gambhir's swing and disappears over midwicket
that's a hit me delivery! Shukla is lucky the fielder was there at the deep.. It was short, not so quick, outside off and Gambhir punched it hard to deep extra cover
looks to work the length delivery to the leg side but gets an inside edge to square leg
collision between the bowler and the batsman! Uthappa was looking to do a KP but common sense prevails.. He turns back but a charging Shukla barges into him
back of length on the pads, the batsman picks a leg bye as it hits the thigh pad
this lands safely at midwicket! He looks to pull the short of length delivery - it surprises him with the pace and hits the splice of the bat to lob towards midwicket where there is no one
bowls this one smartly! He sees the batsman come out of the crease and fires it wide outside off.. Unfortunately the umpire calls it in the batsman's favour
back of length delivery on the body, Gambhir looks to work it away on the on side but gets hit on the body
length delivery on the pads, the batsman nudges it to the right of midwicket for a single
another full delivery, this time it's on off stump. Uthappa punches it to mid-off
comes down the pitch but yorks himself, digs out the ball to cover
he presses forward and crashes the length delivery in front of point, but is not able to beat the fielder
looks to pull the short of length delivery from outside off but gets an inside edge on to his boots.. The ball is deflected to cover and it's almost a run-out.. The throw is a bit wild though
he comes forward and pushes this to mid-on for a single
slower short ball on the off stump line, Gambhir rolls his wrist as he plays this pull to deep square leg
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to the left of mid-on for a single
a tailender's boundary this one! it was a short of length delivery outside off and Uthappa looks to pull it out of the ground only to get a thick outside edge to the third-man boundary

that is beautifully punched over midwicket! Uthappa plays a short-arm jab to one that comes in to him, timed it perfectly. That actually hit the sticker of the bat first, then the middle  -  he hit it twice. Amazing replay that one
back of length delivery on off, Gambhir chops it down to third man
full and swinging, but the line is wrong as it's down the leg side.. It clips the pads to run to the fine leg boundary
that is past the bowler at a catchable height but it was hit with extreme timing! It was a length delivery that was punched past the left of the bowler
he misses out - looks like he didn't spot this early enough - it was a low full toss and the batsman defends it to point
on the pads again - there is a leg slip in place - but Gambhir misses his flick. Gets a leg bye instead
marginally short! this is a superb pull. He leans back and cracks it over midwicket with a lot of timing

he looks to flick this fuller length delivery to the leg side, but is beaten by the inward movement in it, gets hit on the pads.. he looks to sneak in a single but he doesn't know the ball is right in front of him.. Parnell boots it towards the stumps and would have got Gambhir had it hit
another one beats the outside edge! This one is outside off, pitches on a length before darting away. Uthappa looks to drives but is beaten by the movement
back of length delivery outside off, Gambhir plays his trademark guide down to third man

back of length delivery on the pads, Gambhir mistimes it to midwicket - it was in the air for a bit - and charges out of the crease before turning back. Vijay fires the throw in that misses the stumps
good line to Gambhir! It swings a touch towards the off stump, Gambhir pushes it to cover
fuller on the the off and middle line this time, there is still some shape on that but it's flicked down to fine leg for a single
big outswinger at 140 kph from Shami.. Uthappa chases this one as this is wide but is beaten
